main_text.l: eft, & totius Orbis Imperator. Quia e-
nim omnis iurans aut vovens eft Papæ
facit) fibi non placere ut ratum fit
nus ceffare. Quæ fententia fi obtineret,
poffet Papa pro libitu fuo juramenta
quævis refcindere, five fubeffet iufta al-
ia caufa, five non. Rejecta itaque hac
difpenfare poffe in Juramentis, aut Re-
gum contradictus diffolvere, neque id ab
eo fieri, proprie loquendo; tollendo fc.
ab ea eximendo privatam aliquam perfonam:
mentum in eo cafu non obligare, prop-
aut malum quod fequeretur, fi Juramen-tum.

The notes are abbreviated in the scan and are not fully legible, so these readings are approximate; the note in the margin before "illam conditionem" is marked [?]. The marks {a} and {b} stand in the text as printed, with no matching footnote on the page. The final word is printed as "tum." after a hyphen at the line end, and the scan is partly faded at the right edge.
